从草坡到壁画，分三站慢慢看: Three unhurried stops from lawns to murals
三站是编辑推荐的方向，公园到壁画区不是一出门就到；体力不足可另乘交通接续。: This is an editorial route. The mural area is not immediately outside the park; use a separate transit connection if walking the whole distance is too much.
第一站 · Dolores Park 的草坡与城市视野: Stop 1 · Dolores Park lawns and city views
先找一处不挡主路的位置坐下，看草坡与远处的城市轮廓，不必抢到最高处才算看过。带孩: Find somewhere off the main paths to sit and take in the lawns and skyline; the highest point is not essential. Families can begin at Helen Diller Playground and choose age-appropriate equipment. The park is sloped, so stroller users and visitors with limited mobility should use paved paths and choose a comfortable resting spot.
从公园步行或转乘到二十四街，先找午餐和坐下休息的机会，再到 Precita Ey: Walk or take transport to 24th Street, stop for lunch and a seated break, then visit Precita Eyes for mural context. Tour participants should arrive at their booked time. Independent visitors can focus on a few works, noting artists and themes to connect the images with neighborhood life.
第三站 · Balmy Alley 的近距离阅读: Stop 3 · Read the murals of Balmy Alley
走进巷子后先看整面构图，再找人物、标语与色彩的关系；可以和孩子各选一幅，说说自己: First take in a mural’s overall composition, then examine its figures, text, and colors. Invite children to choose a favorite and describe what they see. The alley also contains residents’ entrances and driveways; keep them clear for photos, avoid touching murals or entering private spaces, and return to 24th Street for transport.
按阳光、坡度与同行者体力缩短路线: Adjust for sun, slopes, and your group’s energy
晴天带水、防晒与薄外套；雨天草地不适合久坐，可缩短为壁画区与室内用餐。游乐场有无: Bring water, sunscreen, and a light layer on sunny days. In rain, shorten the outing to the mural area and an indoor meal. Accessible playground entry does not mean every play structure, lawn, or street surface suits a wheelchair. Plan family breaks, cross roads together, and check return transport; allow extra walking or ride time if returning to your original parking spot.
